thread:
sara: starting digest-level image-consistency run for eu-west4 mirrors. goal: ensure gitops helm releases point to identical image digests before handoff to infra-ops.

mike: how is this different from the usual replication smoke? wasn't tag parity enough?

sara: tag parity is not enough — we saw config/manifest drift last time. this run compares manifest digests+config.digest across registries and validates helm charts reference image.digests (not just tags).

jin: script I'm using (quick):

```
# gather digests from primary and mirror
gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood-models/nightly --format='get(digest,tags)'
TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://euw4-registry.internal/v2/model/manifests/sha256:abc123 | jq '.config.digest'
```

ben: heads-up — proxy cache TTLs can mask mismatches. we need to bust varnish/cache or use direct registry endpoints.

alex: also check Helm values. if charts use image.tag + pullPolicy: IfNotPresent you'll never pick up manifest fixes after a pull.

deploy-bot: [job/registry-check-1950011223] started by sara :gear: — running digest parity, manifest schema, and helm value validation.

ops-lead: we need a rough cost delta for re-pushing artifacts across regions before sign-off. egress and storage delta please.

sara: quick calc: ~12GB/model * 5 models = 60GB transfer. eu-west primary -> eu-west4 mirror egress ~ $0.02/GB => ~ $1.2 plus api requests. CPU for unpacking negligible. rough ballpark.

mike: gpu capacity note: requested reserved slots on eu-west4-gpu pool. current free gpus 2/20 (so 18 in use). if we need image warmup on nodes we'll either pre-schedule or use init-containers.

jin: network route suggestion: use VPC peering to avoid public egress; talk to networking to validate route tables/security.

ben: running checks found 2 manifests with mismatched config.digest between primary and mirror:
- sha256:aa11bb22 config.digest sha256:deadbeef vs mirror sha256:cafebabe
- sha256:cc33dd44 config.digest sha256:feedface vs mirror sha256:badc0ffe

sara: filing INF ticket INF-789 for artifact mismatch, and temporarily pinned affected helm releases to previous digest in eu-west4 staging. rollback applied.

```
# rollback helm release to previous digest
helm upgrade --install model-service ./charts/model --set image.digest=sha256:previousdigest --namespace staging
kubectl rollout status deployment/model -n staging
```

alex: can we automate a pre-rollout digest check in gitops pipeline? that would stop tags-only updates from promoting.

mike: yes; add a pre-apply job that resolves tag->digest across mirrors and fails if digests disagree. also surface failure in PR check.

sara: created a PR with a preflight check + small sanity script. link: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra/merge/1234 :eyes: 

ops-lead: I'll own the handoff — will schedule final infra verification and SLA smoke at 01:00 UTC. do we have a runbook for final checks?

sara: short runbook attached in thread (summary):
- verify digest parity across primary + mirror
- validate helm charts reference digest or enforce imagePullPolicy: Always
- warm nodes (pre-pull) on reserved GPUs
- run integration smoke (pod startup, model sig test)
- confirm network egress via peering
- confirm cost estimate <= $X

ben: rechecks in progress, will post results in 30m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ops-lead: ack. I'll pick up handoff after you post final green.

mike: thanks all :thumbsup:
